ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISNEW(), OR(ISBLANK(LastName), ISBLANK(Phone), ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)), ISBLANK(TEXT(AF_Brand__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(AF_VehicleOfInterest__c))))
